sim_s_quote_per_state.rule: every branch charged sim_s = window end_s (sumo_verify.branch_sim_s). Per state: seed 1 = all + n solos + background (+ fresh reference unless the snapshot policy is u3) ; seed 2 = all + n solos + background + reference. Total = 2(n+3)*end_s (fresh seed-1 reference) or (2n+5)*end_s (adopted). Exact values are written into the plan before any execution.
sim_s_quote_per_state.986066_6CAV: 18*end_s (17*end_s if adopted); e.g. end_s 660 -> 11880 sim-s = 2280 over the 9600 registered isolated cap (the seed-1 isolated n+2 set alone = 5280)
sim_s_quote_per_state.cap_policy: per-state overage over ISOLATED_STATE_CAP_SIM_S=9600 is printed to stderr and recorded in plan caps.overages / states[].cost / totals.overage_sim_s; never trimmed or refused. Group > 6 or window end > 1200 still refuse.

open_issues: The 6-CAV two-seed CRN set (18 branches) exceeds the registered isolated 9600 sim-s per-state cap for any window end > 533 s; the overage needs an explicit owner/registration decision before execute (the gate prints it; the ledger phase cap still governs the precharge).

Seed 2 uses a fresh replicate salt ('coopfix_exact:<vid>_seed2'), not the bank confirmation replication seed, so the gate seeds are not the certification selection seeds except seed 1 (the decision snapshot itself).
